brief: A preview of the August CPI report, the last data input before the September 16 FOMC. The chain runs: Thursday's PPI was mixed but the market read it as hawkish and pushed hike odds above 70 percent. Waller has said he supports holding if August inflation shows continued progress and would consider a 25bp hike if it comes in hot, so the print decides the meeting. JPM's economists frame it as 0.2 percent rounded holds and 0.3 percent rounded hikes. Forecasts cluster tightly. Consensus core is 0.2 percent m/m and 2.4 percent y/y with headline 0.4 percent on a gasoline jump. Feroli has 0.21 percent, Bloomberg 0.24 percent, Goldman's inflation desk 24bp core CPI translating to 23bp core PCE. Goldman's components: used cars plus 0.5 percent, new cars plus 0.1 percent, auto insurance minus 0.2 percent, OER plus 0.22 percent, airfares plus 4.0 percent. JPM's grid maps core prints to SPX moves between minus 2.5 percent and plus 2 percent. Desks see asymmetry toward a dovish dollar reaction, USDJPY downside to 152.10, front-end longs into back-ups, and CZK and PLN in EM. Energy is the stated upside risk with WTI back above USD 100.
